audience.programmeDescription: Aerospace Engineering at Delft combines mathematics and physics with aerodynamics, structures, materials, propulsion, flight and space systems. Design projects, experiments, a minor and a final team design exercise connect these subjects.

reviewedInternalPrototypeDescriptions.text: This course is a first-year requirement and aims to stimulate personal development, namely, being able to actively, consciously and ethically orientate oneself in relation to others and the world. reviewedInternalPrototypeDescriptions.name: Consumer Product Design
reviewedInternalPrototypeDescriptions.text: You will learn how to function in a ‘real-world’ design and development team for consumer products. We go through the phases of design and development: probe customer needs, translate these into a product concept, develop a fabrication method, analyze sustainability, analyze costs and proceeds. Design and development involves interviewing customers, brainstorming, laboratory experiments, quantitative modeling, constructing a prototype, and considering protection of intellectual property.

Multi-agent decisions and probabilistic programming extend the analysis, supported by equations, numerical examples and scientific papers.
